svg.aria-label: U.S. citizens and green card holders can use SponsorScan too. Sponsorship data from official DOL H-1B and green card filings; postings straight from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, Eightfold and Amazon; no API keys; alerts by email or Telegram for new jobs only; a local dashboard to track applications.
svg.title: SponsorScan, also for U.S. citizens and green card holders

defs.text: U.S. citizen or green card holder? It works for you too | sponsorship data from official DOL filings, H-1B and green card | postings straight from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, Eightfold and Amazon | drops postings that rule you out: clearance, PhD-required, senior titles, citizenship-only | no API keys, no aggregators | alerts by email or Telegram, only for jobs it has never shown you | a local dashboard to track every application | runs on a schedule in GitHub Actions |
